name: Markets a model would watch
summary: Every hour, a language model reads the markets this workflow has not seen yet, and the ones it would watch come to Telegram with its reason.
description:
The AI agent node asks a language model, with your own key: Anthropic's, an OpenAI-compatible one such as OpenRouter's, or Google's Gemini. Its calls are billed to that key's account, not to Polythought.

Every hour this workflow takes the 10 most liquid open markets and keeps those it has not seen in the last week. For each, the model answers in two fields: watch, true or false, and reason. The markets it would watch come to you on Telegram, with its reason.

Before you start:
- Add your key on the Credentials page, and press Test to check it.
- Pick it here, and name a model the key can use: the Model setting lists them.
- Link Telegram on the Settings page, for the messages.

The first run sees every market, so it asks about all 10; later runs only about markets new to it. Change the Prompt to say what is worth watching to you.

nodes.notes: Runs every hour while the workflow is active. Run also starts it once, for a test.
